scope: Compiler diagnostics only; no native match credit or compiler decision patches.

repeat_comparison.limitations: Pairs function ordinals and hook occurrences. Compares opcode, line, flags, operand kinds, kind-7 payloads, event-local temporary relationships and selected descriptor fields (+04,+0c,+10,+24,+3c) only at the allocation callsites (hook indices 12+). Other operands remain opaque. Equal signatures do not establish semantic equivalence; descriptor field meanings are phase-dependent. Arena IDs may be recycled even within one trace.
